evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: queremos hacer crecer nuestro equipo con personas que tengan ganas de desarrollar software basado en datos con dos objetivos: ayudar en la transformación a nuestros clientes
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD is short on both explicit rigour signals (no testing/governance language) and explicit velocity signals (no 'move fast'/'ship quickly'), reading as generic consultancy framing, so mixed.
evidence.domain_risk: Capacidad para trabajar con negocio y para entender procesos complejos asociados con datos.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The role is a BI/data consultancy engagement affecting client business decisions without stated regulatory or financial-reporting exposure, so moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Al menos 3 años de experiencia como Data Analyst/BI Consultant con un perfil analítico muy marcado.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: This is a consultancy placing a BI/analytics consultant at a client site with named reporting tools already in use (Power BI), indicating a mid-maturity engagement rather than greenfield or fully mature in-house function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Experiencia en herramientas de reporting, como Power BI. Experiencia en nube (AWS y/o Azure).
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Mostly generic consultancy-style requirements (analytical profile, teamwork, English level) mixed with some specific tool names (Power BI, DAX Studio, Tabular Editor), so mixed.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Capacidad para trabajar con negocio y para entender procesos complejos asociados con datos.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role serves internal business reporting/BI needs for a client engagement without a clear commercial, product, or finance skew, so internal_data.
evidence.autonomy_level: Capacidad para trabajar con negocio y para entender procesos complejos asociados con datos.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role is scoped around delivering BI/reporting work at a client site with no language of setting strategy or direction, so execution.

evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal anywhere in the JD.

evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed purely in delivery, growth and cultural terms with no risk, compliance, or reliability register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Conocimientos sobre el diseño y optimización de bases de datos analíticas.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mix of designing new analytical database structures and optimizing/maintaining existing reporting tools, with limited detail either way.
evidence.work_arrangement: Disponibilidad de desplazarse a las oficinas del cliente de L-V sitadas en Madrid.
